_about: 3-08, added in step 140 (G2): lift_ent_1532 waits at its foot until a touch inside it sends it
(ETHCallback_lift), at 60 units a second, and a touch on it fires no shot ("shot": false). Ten portals,
the level's golden score. From the start a portal over the octagon block at (420, 136), under the upper
floor's slab and over the block, and one on the player: out onto the block, off it into the corridor under
the middle floor, and left behind knight C (minion_spawn_1255, walking to its wayC1 on the lift). A touch
sends the lift up (340) before the knight reaches it, and the knight walks off the floor's end into the
open column and falls to enemy_killer_1140 (454). A portal in the column at (100, 195) (457, the lift at the
top: a lift passing 195 stops the shot); a touch brings the lift down (501); left onto the lift and a touch
sends it up (690); right along the middle floor to the pillar. A portal at (232, 30) beside knight B
(minion_spawn_913, holding at wayB0 beside the key): the knight goes through, comes out at (100, 195) over the
empty column and falls (994). A portal at (240, 20) over the key's ledge and one on the player: left to
key_ent_1335 (taken 1017), right off the ledge, left along the middle floor onto the lift, and a touch sends
it down (1144). Right along the corridor to x 381; a portal at (440, 125) over the octagon block (6 units over
its bevel) and one on the player; from the block a portal at (530, 100) over the right floor's slab and one on
the player; right: the key opens keyhole_1338, door_locked_ent_1343 goes, and into the door. Leans on G1
(no knight sees or shoots) and on a knight walking off a floor's end into a pit, as the original's does
(ETHCallback_minion walks toward its waypoint's x with no floor probe: its one ray, #943, is the sight
line; ETHBeginContactCallback_enemy_killer ends it).
Re-authored on wave 3a's timing build (R3, round 1): each shot flies 3.2 px a tick after a 24-unit jump
(G4), so a shot waits for the one before it to land (113, 499, 950, 988, 1430, 1502), each next tap two ticks
after the landing, and the 400 ms is 26 ticks; the player walks 144 u/s (G10), so every walk is shorter. The
taps at (232, 30), (440, 125) and (530, 100) wait for the camera to settle (the aim drifts under 0.25 px).
Knight C walks to the column on its own clock and falls on tick 454 whatever tick the lift is touched between
240 and 345. Won on tick 1663. Every tap and walk edge 3 ticks either way wins (bar the later side of a shot
whose follower waits on its landing, and the earlier side of a follower held by the 26 ticks).
